notes.title: Update #4 (Early Access 1.0.5)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released update number 4, which has some changes to the game, in addition to optimization, and bug fixes. Full list can be found below:


Mouse slider should now be fixed and give a greater degree of mouse control.
Save files now contain time-stamps.
Spelling and grammar overhaul (big thanks to @foofaraw for the help).
Save files now list the correct amount of save slots, and are labeled correctly.
The flashlight retains it's state it was last in, when loading a save file or after completing an ending.
Items that move in the morgue now retain their last state and position on load.
General optimization improvements in the morgue.
Version number updated to reflect current game version.


More to follow soon. As always, any issues, please post them in the discussion page if not already listed.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We have had a number of reports relating to the mouse speed. To address this issue we have just released an update that should now for a greater degree in control when manipulating the mouse speed slider in the game options.

If this slider is still not satisfactory, then please post in the discussion thread, and we will modify the variables further.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

This is a small one, but we feel it's quite important since it breaks game immersion.

1) Complete spelling and grammar overhaul. (if you do spot any incorrect spelling however, please let us know)
2) Stopped player clipping into the walls, which caused the player to fall through the floor.
3) Few optimization improvements.

We will be posting more updates very soon.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update #1 Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that fir first update is ready and should be now available (may require Steam to be restarted).  Please find below a list of changes made in this update.


Added 2 more paranormal based instances in the basement area.
Pressing escape to close the pause menu should now lock the cursor to the screen center.
Piano keys should now be returnable after loading a game.
After returning the piano keys, the door it unlocks should now open after loading/completing game.
On loading a game save, the safe should now stay open.
The chest that the flashlight is in, now stays open on loading a game.
Basement chest now stays open on loading a game.
Changed several instances where triggers where not deactivating, allowing for multiple activations, which caused issues to sounds playing.
Monster changed to be slightly more visible.
Changed the timing of the music to co-inside with paranormal events.
Kitchen shelf now contains Kitchen related items, and not towels.
Move location of floating items in the bathroom.
Piano notes are now easier to press/play.
Update of some spelling and grammatical errors.
Basement walls now saves correctly, which would cause the game from being finish-able.
Living room wall now saves correctly.
Version number updated to version 1.0.2 accordingly on main menu.


More to follow.

Thanks

Deceptive Games
